prompt: My HomePod mini says it cannot connect to the internet when I ask Siri questions. What should I check first?
expected: Scopes the incident, captures HomePod version and home-hub status, tests local network and Home app control, and uses targeted reversible checks before reset.
actual: Classified the issue as network, home-hub, permission, or service related; requested one-device versus whole-home scope; checked HomePod software, home-hub status, and Home app control; then recommended reproducible network checks before reset.

prompt: A weekday 8 AM Home automation sometimes plays music in the wrong room. Help me troubleshoot it without disrupting the rest of the house.
expected: Uses one canonical automation, validates trigger/conditions/targets, runs controlled trials, requires approval for changes, and defines rollback and completion criteria.
actual: Isolated the weekday automation, recorded its trigger and expected versus actual room, checked naming and target state, proposed one approved change at a time, and required three controlled passes with no unrelated-room side effects before retaining the fix.
